title: A Topological Sorting Criterion for Random Causal Directed Acyclic Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2605.06288v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Random directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) based on imposing an order on Erd\H{o}s-R\'enyi or scale-free graphs are widely used to generate synthetic data from causal models, in particular for evaluating causal discovery algorithms. We show that the set of nodes reachable via open paths, termed relatives, never decreases along the causal order in all DAGs. We find that it tends to increase strictly for DAGs with certain density parameters, and demonstrate that this pattern can be exploited for causal discovery via sorting by the estimated number of relatives. We note that many simulations in the literature are focused on a narrow range of parameter settings where sorting by relatives yields an excellent proxy for the causal order, and show that a strict increase of relatives leads to a singleton Markov equivalence class. translated_title: 随机因果有向无环图的拓扑排序准则
translated_abstract: 基于对Erdős-Rényi图或无标度图施加顺序而生成的随机有向无环图（DAG）被广泛用于从因果模型生成合成数据，尤其是用于评估因果发现算法。我们证明了在所有DAG中，经由开放路径可达的节点集合（称为“亲属”）沿因果顺序从不减少。我们发现，对于具有某些密度参数的DAG，该集合倾向于严格增加，并证明这一模式可以通过按估计的亲属数量进行排序来用于因果发现。我们注意到文献中的许多模拟都集中在狭窄的参数设置范围内，在这些设置中按亲属排序可以很好地代理因果顺序，并证明亲属的严格增加会导致单元素马尔可夫等价类。我们提出采样时间序列DAG作为一种可能的替代方案，并讨论了其对因果发现的影响。
tldr: 该论文发现随机DAG中可达节点集合（亲属数）沿因果顺序单调不减、且在特定密度参数下严格增加，据此提出按估计亲属数排序进行因果发现的新准则，并指出许多文献模拟恰好集中于该准则表现极佳的狭窄参数范围。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the set of reachable nodes ("relatives") never decreases along the causal order in random DAGs and strictly increases for certain density parameters, proposes sorting by estimated number of relatives as a novel causal discovery criterion, and reveals that many simulations in the literature focus on a narrow parameter range where this criterion yields an excellent proxy for the causal order.
